Philologist of the Pratyabhijna margins: discovered Vivrti fragments in manuscript margins (J11 etc.), edited/translated them, and mapped the Buddhist co-optation. The single most load-bearing secondary for IPVV: where she has edited text, follow her; where she argues, weigh her.
